# Anizuki

> Anizuki is a high-speed, real-time multiplayer anime trivia and battle arena built on the "human robo" paradigm—blending human otaku trivia curation with automated, zero-latency room and matchmaking architecture.

## Overview
- **Name:** Anizuki
- **Website:** https://anizuki.sbs/
- **Creator / Lead Engineer:** Promised Killua (also known as nerfed_killua)
- **Developer Portfolio:** https://www.promisedkillua.sbs/
- **Core Stack:** Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Node.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS

## What Makes Anizuki Unique ("The Human Robo Paradigm")
1. **Automated Match Engine:** Instant room generation, 6-character PIN access, real-time WebSockets synchronization, and automated bot players with zero human friction.
2. **Deep Canonical Anime Lore:** Hand-crafted, 9-tier difficulty questions covering massive franchises including One Piece, Jujutsu Kaisen (Gojo vs. Sukuna), Naruto, Bleach, Attack on Titan, Dragon Ball Z, Demon Slayer, and more.
3. **Instant Accessibility:** Zero-email signup requirement, persistent local sessions, and cross-device responsive light-mode design.
